headlines.title: With Military Moves Seen in Ukraine, Obama Warns Russia
headlines.abstract: The new Ukrainian government claimed that Russia was trying to provoke a military conflict by sending troops to Crimea, while President Obama warned Russia to respect Ukraine’s sovereignty.

headlines.title: Russian 'invasion' of Crimea fuels fear of Ukraine conflict
Ukraine Finds Its Forces Are Ill Equipped to Take Crimea Back From Russia
headlines.abstract: In the autonomous region of Crimea, the Ukrainian military has only a token force with light weapons, and it lacks the country’s advanced battle tanks, a Russian military expert said.

headlines.title: Ukraine on high alert as Russia advances into Crimea - video
Ukraine PM warns of war as Russian military seizes control in Crimea
